name: mercenary_mounted
description: a Mounted Mercenary, a bearded cavalryman in a steel helmet with a tall red crest, a brown cloak, gold scale armour and a red-and-orange striped skirt, a steel-tipped wooden spear held level in his RIGHT hand on the screen-left side, pointing forward to the right, and a round orange shield with a gold boss on his LEFT arm on the screen-right side, riding a tan horse with a dark brown mane and tail, a brown bridle and dark hooves
hands: the spear stays in the rider's right hand on the screen-left side and the round orange shield on his left arm on the screen-right side
